text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 25px; font-family: 'Helvetica Neue'; text-anchor: middle

g.text: How long are the evaluated audio clips?
Physical file duration, measured from audio headers on the exact evaluated clips
Orange: conversational datasets. Blue: other datasets. Every dataset contributes one panel.
Clip duration (seconds; bins have different widths)
Heights show percentages per bin, not probability density. Labels round to whole percentages.
